title: Holy basil infusion for daily calm
subtitle: A warming daily tea of tulsi leaf for stress and anxiety
excerpt: Holy basil infusion is a simple hot brew of dried tulsi leaf taken once or twice a day as a settling, mildly warming drink. Traditionally prepared in Ayurvedic home practice for daily use during stressful periods, it has a clove-like, slightly peppery flavour. Three cups' worth keeps in a tea strainer; the dried leaf keeps 12 months in a sealed tin.
sourceNotes: WHO monographs on selected medicinal plants vol. 4 (2009), Herba Ocimi Sancti (Tulasi). Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Ayurvedic classical text, tulasi entry. David Winston & Steven Maimes, Adaptogens (2007), holy basil chapter.

glossaryTerms.definition: The Sanskrit and Hindi name for holy basil (Ocimum tenuiflorum), the sacred herb of Ayurvedic medicine used as a daily tonic and adaptogen in Indian home practice.

content.text: leaf brewed in just-boiled water for 10 minutes, covered, and drunk warm. Traditionally made as a daily tea in Ayurvedic home practice during periods of stress, anxiety, or sustained demand. The taste is aromatic, slightly clove-like, and mildly peppery, more like a spiced herb tea than an ordinary basil. One cup a day for several weeks.

attrs.title: Precautions
attrs.body: Not medical advice. Consult a qualified herbalist or doctor before use. Full precautions are in the 'When not to use' section.

items.prepNote: dried holy basil leaf and stems

content.text: Place 1 teaspoon of dried holy basil leaf in a teapot or heatproof cup.
Pour 200 ml of just-boiled water over the herb. Cover the teapot or place a saucer over the cup to keep the aromatic oils from escaping.
Steep for 10 minutes. Strain into a cup and drink warm. A little honey rounds out the flavour.

One to two cups a day, taken over several weeks. Holy basil is a daily-use herb in the Ayurvedic tradition, not a short-course acute remedy. Take for 4 to 8 weeks then reassess. Best taken in the morning or at midday. not specifically sedating but some people find it quieting enough to interfere with concentration if taken in large amounts in the evening.
Dried holy basil stores 12 months in a sealed tin away from light and heat. Prepare each cup fresh. do not store the prepared infusion.
When not to use this remedy

See a doctor for anxiety that significantly disrupts daily life, that involves panic attacks, or that came on suddenly without an obvious life stressor. Herbal support during a stressful period is appropriate. herbal treatment of an anxiety disorder is not.
